name: Kogda plachut pionery: Vtoroj krug
source:
"The Second Circle" is a small amateur essay by a mad author, telling about how one of the unlucky Persunov gets into one of the camps, and what happened when he went through the second circle...
BUT THAT'S JUST THE TIP OF THE ICEBERG... for he will not be the only one who has gone for the second time...
